title: Korean-Style Steamed Mandu with Collards
description: A traditional Chinese-inspired dish featuring steamed mandu filled with collard greens and served with a side of briny dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: briny
ingredients.notes: dipping sauce ingredients: soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, water

instructions: 1. Prepare the dipping sauce by combining soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, and water in a small bowl.
2. Blanch the collard greens in boiling water for 30 seconds. Drain and set aside.
3. In a pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and grated ginger. Cook for 1 minute.
4. Add the chopped collard greens to the pan and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
5. Remove the mandu from their packaging and place them in a steamer basket.
6. Steam the mandu over boiling water for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
7. Serve the steamed mandu with the collard green and garlic filling, garnished with chopped scallions and served with the briny dipping sauce.
8. Enjoy your delicious Korean-Style Steamed Mandu with Collards!
